implementation: Fibonacci Next replaces weighted-tap rescans with two exact rolling accumulators: Anew=Bold+F(L)*new; Bnew=Aold-Bold+F(L-1)*new-expired. Round only the published quotient. Historical static Compute is unchanged. Recurrence tests cover 14 periods, preview/reset, nonfinite rejection and large Fibonacci weights. Shared Fibonacci, square-root and sine states bound rolling history by owned count while retaining original-period weights and denominators. Arithmetic operation count no longer scales with Fibonacci tap count; BigInteger cost and runtime remain unmeasured.
performance: No measured latency/allocation claim; no competitor benchmarks rerun.
